sources.title: 2026年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（08）
sources.quote: 境外个人在境内工作期间取得的劳动报酬如何购汇汇出？ 答：根据《国家外汇管理局关于印发〈经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）〉的通知》（汇发〔2020〕14号）第五十九条规定，“境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇”。
sources.en: How does an overseas individual buy and remit foreign exchange with pay earned in China? Under Art. 59 of the Current Account FX Guidelines (2020), lawful current-account RMB income earned in China is converted at a bank on the person's valid ID plus source-of-funds documents showing the amount, including tax vouchers.

sources.title: 2026年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（10）
sources.quote: 境外个人原兑换未用完的人民币兑回外汇，凭本人有效身份证件和原兑换水单办理，原兑换水单的兑回有效期为自兑换日起24个月；对于当日累计兑换不超过等值500美元（含）以及离境前在境内关外场所当日累计不超过等值1000美元（含）的兑换，可凭本人有效身份证件办理。
sources.en: An overseas individual may convert back unused RMB that was originally exchanged from foreign currency, on valid ID plus the original exchange memo, valid 24 months from the exchange date. Up to USD 500 a day (USD 1,000 a day at airside counters before departure) needs ID only.

sources.title: 2024年经常项目外汇政策问答案例（九）
sources.quote: 境外个人是否享受年度便利化额度购汇？ … 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇。持有外国人永久居留身份证的境外个人适用购汇年度便利化额度。
sources.en: Do overseas individuals get the annual facilitation quota for buying FX? They buy against ID plus source-of-funds documents including tax vouchers. Overseas individuals holding a Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card are covered by the annual purchase quota.

sources.title: 《个人外汇管理办法实施细则》（已修改） (Implementing Rules)
sources.quote: 第二条 对个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度总额管理。年度总额分别为每人每年等值5万美元。 … 第十三条 境外个人经常项目合法人民币收入购汇及未用完的人民币兑回，按以下规定办理：（一）在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的相关证明材料（含税务凭证）办理购汇。
sources.en: Art. 2: an annual total applies to FX settlement by individuals and to FX purchases by domestic individuals — USD 50,000 equivalent per person per year each. Art. 13(1): overseas individuals convert lawful current-account RMB income on ID plus documents showing the amount, including tax vouchers.

sources.publisher: People's Bank of China (hosted by SAFE)
sources.title: 《个人外汇管理办法》 (PBOC Decree [2006] No. 3)
sources.quote: 第十三条 境外个人在境内取得的经常项目项下合法人民币收入，可以凭本人有效身份证件及相关证明材料在银行办理购汇及汇出。 第十四条 境外个人未使用的境外汇入外汇，可以凭本人有效身份证件在银行办理原路汇回。 … 第二十八条 银行按照个人开户时提供的身份证件等证明材料确定账户主体类别 … 第三十七条 （一）境内个人是指持有中华人民共和国居民身份证、军人身份证件、武装警察身份证件的中国公民。（二）境外个人是指持护照、港澳居民来往内地通行证、台湾居民来往大陆通行证的外国公民（包括无国籍人）以及港澳台同胞。
sources.en: Art. 13: overseas individuals may buy and remit FX with lawful current-account RMB income on ID and supporting documents. Art. 14: unused foreign exchange remitted in from abroad may be sent back by the same route on ID. Art. 28: the bank classifies the account by the ID shown at opening. Art. 37: a domestic individual is a Chinese citizen holding a PRC resident ID; an overseas individual is a foreign citizen holding a passport (or an HK/Macau/Taiwan permit holder).

sources.title: 《中华人民共和国外汇管理条例》 (State Council Decree No. 532)
sources.quote: 第三十九条 有违反规定将境内外汇转移境外，或者以欺骗手段将境内资本转移境外等逃汇行为的，由外汇管理机关责令限期调回外汇，处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款；构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。 第四十条 有违反规定以外汇收付应当以人民币收付的款项，或者以虚假、无效的交易单证等向经营结汇、售汇业务的金融机构骗购外汇等非法套汇行为的，由外汇管理机关责令对非法套汇资金予以回兑，处非法套汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处非法套汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款；构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。 … 第四十五条 私自买卖外汇、变相买卖外汇、倒买倒卖外汇或者非法介绍买卖外汇数额较大的，由外汇管理机关给予警告，没收违法所得，处违法金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处违法金额30%以上等值以下的罚款；构成犯罪的，依法追究刑事责任。 … 第五十二条 （二）境内个人，是指中国公民和在中华人民共和国境内连续居住满1年的外国人，外国驻华外交人员和国际组织驻华代表除外。
sources.en: Art. 39 (capital flight): ordered to repatriate, fined up to 30% of the amount; serious cases 30% up to the full amount; criminal liability where a crime. Art. 40 (obtaining FX with false or invalid documents): ordered to convert back, same fine scale. Art. 45 (private or disguised buying and selling of FX in large amounts): warning, confiscation of illegal gains, same fine scale. Art. 52(2): 'domestic individual' means Chinese citizens and foreigners who have lived in China continuously for one year.

sources.title: 《国家外汇管理局关于进一步完善个人外汇管理有关问题的通知》 (Hui Fa [2015] No. 49)
sources.quote: 二、个人在办理外汇业务时，应当遵守个人外汇管理有关规定，不得以分拆等方式规避额度及真实性管理。国家外汇管理局及其分支局（以下简称外汇局）对规避额度及真实性管理的个人实施“关注名单”管理。 … （二）外汇局对以借用他人额度等方式规避额度及真实性管理的个人，列入“关注名单”管理 … （三）“关注名单”内个人的关注期限为列入“关注名单”的当年及之后连续2年。
sources.en: Individuals may not split transactions or use similar means to evade the quota and authenticity checks. Anyone who borrows another person's quota is put on a watch list for the current year and the following two years; a person who lends a quota gets a risk warning and is listed on repetition.

sources.publisher: People's Bank of China (hosted by SAFE)
sources.title: 《个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法》 (PBOC Announcement [2004] No. 16)
sources.quote: 第六条 移民转移必须一次性申请拟转移出境的全部财产金额，分步汇出。首次可汇出金额不得超过全部申请转移财产的一半；自首次汇出满一年后，可汇出不超过剩余财产的一半；自首次汇出满两年后，可汇出全部剩余财产。全部申请转移财产在等值人民币20万元以下（含20万元）的，经批准后可一次性汇出。 从同一被继承人继承的全部财产变现后拟转移出境的，必须一次性申请，可一次或分次汇出。 … （六）申请转移财产所在地或收入来源地主管税务机关开具的税收证明或完税凭证。
sources.en: Art. 6: an emigrant transfer must be applied for once for the whole amount and remitted in stages — at most half first; at most half of the remainder one year after the first remittance; the balance two years after it. A total of RMB 200,000 or less may go in one remittance after approval. Property inherited from one decedent is applied for once and may be remitted in one or several payments. A tax certificate from the tax authority is required.

sources.title: 深化跨境投融资外汇管理便利化政策操作指引 (operational guide, attachment)
sources.quote: 四、境外个人转让境内商品房所得资金购汇汇出 … 2.房地产主管部门登记备案的商品房转让合同及登记证明文件。 3.主管税务部门出具的税务凭证 … 1.申请人申请汇出金额不得超出商品房转让金额扣减本次转让所包括的税费后的余额。 … 2.银行应审核税务证明中记载金额与申请汇出金额是否一致，申请汇出金额超出税务证明记载金额的不得办理。 3.办理资金汇出时，转让商品房应已在房产主管部门办理权属转移手续。
sources.en: Overseas individuals remitting proceeds from selling housing in China: registered sale contract and registration proof; tax voucher from the tax authority. The amount may not exceed the sale price less the taxes of that sale; the bank checks the amount against the tax certificate; title transfer must already be registered.

sources.title: 移民财产转移购付汇核准 办事指南 (service guide citing the 2024 Capital Account Guidelines)
sources.quote: 《资本项目外汇业务指引（2024年版）》（汇发〔2024〕12号文印发）… 6.4.3.1移民财产转移 （1）书面申请，并附《个人财产转移业务申请表》。 （2）申请人身份证明文件。 … 移居前户籍所在地公安机关出具的境内户籍注销证明。 （3）申请人收入来源证明以及财产权利证明文件。 … （4）主管税务部门出具的税务证明原件（按规定无需提交的除外）
sources.en: Emigrant transfer file under the 2024 Capital Account Guidelines: written application and form; identity documents; proof of cancellation of mainland household registration; proof of income source and of title to the assets; original tax certificate from the tax authority.

sources.title: 外汇局有关负责人就规范银行卡境外大额提取现金交易答记者问 (Q&A on Hui Fa [2017] No. 29)
sources.quote: 一是个人持境内银行卡在境外提取现金，本人名下银行卡（含附属卡）合计每个自然年度不得超过等值10万元人民币。 二是将人民币卡、外币卡境外提取现金每卡每日额度统一为等值1万元人民币。 三是个人持境内银行卡境外提取现金超过年度额度的，本年及次年将被暂停持境内银行卡在境外提取现金。
sources.en: Overseas cash withdrawals on mainland bank cards: at most RMB 100,000 equivalent per person per calendar year across all cards; RMB 10,000 equivalent per card per day; exceeding the annual cap suspends overseas withdrawals for that year and the next.

sources.publisher: SAFE and General Administration of Customs (re-posted by SAFE Tianjin)
sources.title: 《携带外币现钞出入境管理暂行办法》 (Hui Fa [2003] No. 102)
sources.quote: 出境人員攜帶不超過等值5000美元（含5000美元）的外幣現鈔出境的，無須申領《攜帶證》，海關予以放行；出境人員攜帶外幣現鈔金額在等值5000美元以上至10000美元（含10000美元）的，應向外匯指定銀行申領《攜帶證》，海關憑加蓋外匯指定銀行印章的《攜帶證》驗放；出境人員原則上不得攜帶超過等值10000美元的外幣現鈔出境
sources.en: Leaving China with foreign banknotes: up to USD 5,000 equivalent needs no permit; above USD 5,000 up to USD 10,000 needs a carrying permit issued by a bank; above USD 10,000 is not allowed in principle.

sources.title: 中国人民银行公告〔2004〕第18号
sources.quote: 中国公民出入境、外国人入出境每人每次携带的人民币限额由原来的6000元调整为20000元。 本规定自2005年1月1日施行。
sources.en: RMB banknotes carried across the border: limit raised from CNY 6,000 to CNY 20,000 per person per trip.

sources.publisher: Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate
sources.title: 关于办理非法从事资金支付结算业务、非法买卖外汇刑事案件适用法律若干问题的解释 (Fa Shi [2019] No. 1)
sources.quote: （一）非法经营数额在五百万元以上的； （二）违法所得数额在十万元以上的。 … 应当认定为非法经营行为“情节特别严重”： （一）非法经营数额在二千五百万元以上的； （二）违法所得数额在五十万元以上的。
sources.en: Illegal FX trading is 'serious' (the crime of illegal business operation) at RMB 5 million of turnover or RMB 100,000 of illegal gains; 'especially serious' at RMB 25 million or RMB 500,000.

sources.publisher: People's Bank of China and seven other authorities
sources.title: 关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币等相关风险的通知（银发〔2026〕42号）
sources.quote: 在境内开展法定货币与虚拟货币兑换业务…一律严格禁止，坚决依法取缔。 … 金融机构（含非银行支付机构）不得为虚拟货币相关业务活动提供账户开立、资金划转和清算结算等服务 … （十九）任何单位和个人投资虚拟货币、现实世界资产代币及相关金融产品，违背公序良俗的，相关民事法律行为无效，由此引发的损失由其自行承担 … 本通知自发布之日起施行。中国人民银行等十部门《关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币交易炒作风险的通知》（银发〔2021〕237号）同时废止。
sources.en: Exchanging legal tender for virtual currency in China is strictly prohibited. Financial institutions may not open accounts, move funds or settle for virtual-currency business. Investments contrary to public order are void and losses are borne by the investor. This notice repeals Yin Fa [2021] No. 237.

sources.title: 中国是否承认双重国籍？ (FAQ citing the Nationality Law)
sources.quote: 根据《中华人民共和国国籍法》的有关规定，中国不承认中国公民具有双重国籍。定居外国的中国公民，自愿加入或取得外国国籍的，即自动丧失中国国籍。中国公民丧失中国国籍后，应注销中国户籍和中国居民身份证，不再享有中国公民的权利和义务。
sources.en: China does not recognise dual nationality. A Chinese citizen settled abroad who voluntarily acquires foreign nationality automatically loses Chinese nationality, and should then cancel the household registration and resident ID card.

sources.title: 2018 RMB Internationalization Report (Chinese text)
sources.quote: 2018年1月，中国人民银行发布《关于进一步完善人民币跨境业务政策促进贸易投资便利化的通知》：一是明确凡依法可使用外汇结算的跨境交易，企业都可以使用人民币结算。二是开展个人其他经常项目人民币结算业务，满足个人项下雇员报酬、社会福利、赡家款等人民币跨境结算需要。
sources.en: The January 2018 PBOC notice opened RMB settlement of individuals' other current-account items, covering employee pay, social benefits and family-support remittances across the border.

sources.title: 国家税务总局 国家外汇管理局公告2013年第40号 (tax filing for outward payments)
sources.quote: 一、境内机构和个人向境外单笔支付等值5万美元以上（不含等值5万美元，下同）下列外汇资金，除本公告第三条规定的情形外，均应向所在地主管税务机关进行税务备案 … 四、境外个人办理服务贸易、收益和经常转移项下对外支付，应按照个人外汇管理的相关规定办理。
sources.en: Domestic institutions and individuals paying abroad more than USD 50,000 in a single payment for listed items must file with the tax authority first. Overseas individuals follow the individual FX rules instead.

sources.title: 《中华人民共和国个人所得税法》 (Individual Income Tax Law)
sources.quote: （六）利息、股息、红利所得；（七）财产租赁所得；（八）财产转让所得；（九）偶然所得。 … 第三条 个人所得税的税率：（一）综合所得，适用百分之三至百分之四十五的超额累进税率（税率表附后）；（二）经营所得，适用百分之五至百分之三十五的超额累进税率（税率表附后）；（三）利息、股息、红利所得，财产租赁所得，财产转让所得和偶然所得，适用比例税率，税率为百分之二十。
sources.en: Nine taxable categories (wages, labour remuneration, author's remuneration, royalties, business income, interest/dividends, property lease, property transfer, incidental income). Rates: comprehensive income 3%–45%; business income 5%–35%; interest, dividends, lease, property transfer and incidental income a flat 20%.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Finance and State Taxation Administration
sources.title: 财税〔2008〕132号 (deposit interest)
sources.quote: 自2008年10月9日起，对储蓄存款利息所得暂免征收个人所得税。
sources.en: From 9 October 2008, individual income tax on savings-deposit interest is temporarily not levied.

sources.title: 财税函〔2017〕197号 (reply to a CPPCC proposal)
sources.quote: 我国目前并未开征遗产税，也从未发布遗产税相关条例或条例草案。
sources.en: China does not currently levy an inheritance tax and has never issued inheritance-tax regulations or a draft. Statement dated 2017; no later statement was retrieved.

sources.publisher: Ministry of Finance and State Taxation Administration
sources.title: 财政部 税务总局公告2019年第74号
sources.quote: 符合以下情形的，对当事双方不征收个人所得税： （一）房屋产权所有人将房屋产权无偿赠与配偶、父母、子女、祖父母、外祖父母、孙子女、外孙子女、兄弟姐妹； （二）房屋产权所有人将房屋产权无偿赠与对其承担直接抚养或者赡养义务的抚养人或者赡养人； （三）房屋产权所有人死亡，依法取得房屋产权的法定继承人、遗嘱继承人或者受遗赠人。
sources.en: No individual income tax for either party where housing is given free to a spouse, parent, child, grandparent, grandchild or sibling; to a person who supports the owner; or passes on the owner's death to a statutory heir, testamentary heir or legatee. Other free transfers of housing are taxed to the recipient as incidental income.

sources.title: 26 U.S.C. 988 — Treatment of certain foreign currency transactions
sources.quote: (2) Exclusion for certain personal transactions If— (A) nonfunctional currency is disposed of by an individual in any transaction, and (B) such transaction is a personal transaction, no gain shall be recognized for purposes of this subtitle by reason of changes in exchange rates after such currency was acquired by such individual and before such disposition. The preceding sentence shall not apply if the gain which would otherwise be recognized on the transaction exceeds $200.

sources.title: Publication 525 (2025), Taxable and Nontaxable Income
sources.quote: If you have a gain on a personal foreign currency transaction because of changes in exchange rates, you don’t have to include that gain in your income unless it’s more than $200. If the gain is more than $200, report it as a capital gain.

sources.title: Topic no. 409, Capital gains and losses
sources.quote: Generally, if you hold the asset for more than one year before you dispose of it, your capital gain or loss is long-term. If you hold it one year or less, your capital gain or loss is short-term. … For taxable years beginning in 2025, the tax rate on most net capital gain is no higher than 15% for most individuals. A capital gains rate of 0% applies if your taxable income is less than or equal to: $48,350 for single and married filing separately; $96,700 for married filing jointly … a capital gains rate of 20% applies to the extent that your taxable income exceeds the thresholds set for the 15% capital gain rate.

sources.title: 31 CFR 1010.821 — Penalty adjustment and table
sources.as_of: eCFR up to date as of 11/06/2026
sources.quote: 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(B)(i) | Foreign Financial Agency Transaction—Non-Willful Violation of Transaction | 10,000 | 16,536 … 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(C)(i)(I) | Foreign Financial Agency Transaction—Willful Violation of Transaction | 100,000 | 165,353 … penalties assessed on or after January 17, 2025

sources.title: Summary of FATCA reporting for U.S. taxpayers
sources.quote: If you are single or file separately from your spouse, you must submit a Form 8938 if you have more than $200,000 of specified foreign financial assets at the end of the year and you live abroad; or more than $50,000, if you live in the United States. … a $10,000 failure to file penalty, an additional penalty of up to $50,000 for continued failure to file after IRS notification, and a 40 percent penalty on an understatement of tax attributable to non-disclosed assets.

sources.title: Instructions for Form 3520 (Rev. December 2025)
sources.quote: Check “Yes” if during the current tax year, you received more than $100,000 that you treated as gifts or bequests from a nonresident alien … a penalty equal to 5% of the amount of such foreign gifts applies for each month for which the failure to report continues (not to exceed a total of 25%). … No penalty will be imposed if the taxpayer can demonstrate that the failure to comply was due to reasonable cause and not willful neglect.

sources.title: CBP news release, 16 July 2026 (currency reporting reminder)
sources.quote: There is no limit to the amount of currency or other monetary instruments travelers may transport into or out of the United States. However, anyone transporting more than $10,000 in currency or monetary instruments into or out of the country must report the funds by filing a FinCEN Form 105, Report of International Transportation of Currency or Monetary Instruments. Failure to report currency or filing a false report may result in the seizure of the currency and could lead to civil or criminal penalties.
